summary.text: Laurie Warnock is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator who has worked at the Northern New England Poison Center, she is also a Hampstead selectwoman, according to her Ballotpedia survey answers.

paragraphs.text: Laurie Warnock earned a bachelor's degree from Connecticut College in 1984 and a master's degree from the University of New Hampshire in 2011.
Her professional experience includes working as an education coordinator at the Northern New England Poison Center.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Hampstead since 1989, was a volunteer and then call emergency medical technician with the Hampstead Fire Department, and is a trustee of the Alexander Eastman Foundation.
Warnock appears in Ballotpedia's campaign-finance listing as having lost the general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 13 in 2020 and Rockingham 15 in 2022 and 2024.
In her 2026 survey answers, she described herself as a selectwoman for the past six years and said she wants to preserve local control over planning, zoning and municipal and school budgets.

She also said she supports legalizing recreational cannabis, with a portion of any revenue designated for treatment and prevention, and listed protecting Social Security and Medicare among her policy priorities.
